name: Takashima Kirihiko
source:
An old acquaintance of [url=https://vndb.org/c10013]Natsuki[/url] from high school. He is in a way his drinking partner and his confidant.

He serves as a model for [url=https://vndb.org/c10020]Tsukumo[/url]'s story of his sister's fake boyfriend. 

He apparently met Tsukumo once in the past when he was younger - but Tsukumo is sure he never met him before - and he also adds that they were the same age at the time ...

[spoiler]It is thanks to him and his research that Tsukumo knows the cause of Natsuki's death.[/spoiler]

He has the same last name as [url=/c9176]Takashima Kimihiko[/url] from PurexCure and [url=/c9231]Takashima Haruhiko[/url] from Koibumi Romantica; the three of them also have a similar appearance, personality AND occupation.
